notes.vintage_attribution: Clean per-epoch delta, NOT a cumulative snapshot. Most balances are far below the epoch-1785974400 pot (USDC 38.31 -> 6.88, BETR 56,491,772 -> 1,043,344, tGBP 0.020060 -> 0.000985) and kVCM disappeared entirely. An unclaimed cumulative balance cannot decrease, so the prior pot was claimed before this table was taken. The carryover caveat recorded against epoch 1785974400 does not apply here.
notes.price_precision: Operator USD values are rounded to cents, so derived prices inherit that error. oHYDX and tGBP were reported as '< $0.01'; both are priced from the vote-time auto_voter_snap (ts=1786578966) instead of a derived value: oHYDX 0.0095886 -> $0.0024, tGBP 1.35 -> $0.0013. Combined they are under $0.01 and immaterial.
notes.cbBTC_discrepancy: UNRESOLVED, immaterial. The table gives 0.000003600 cbBTC = $0.02, implying $5,556/cbBTC, but the vote-time snapshot price is $63,336 (cbBTC decimals=8, corrected in the 2026-08 decimals fix). At the snapshot price the row is worth $0.228, ~10x the reported value; either the amount is ~10x overstated or the USD ~10x understated. Recorded as reported. Worst-case understatement of the total is $0.21 (0.16%).
notes.WOLF_stale_price: WOLF implied price 5.18e-06 vs snapshot 2.00e-06 (2.59x). The snapshot value is stale - its latest historical_token_prices row is ts=1782950165, ~42 days before the boundary - so the optimizer valued WOLF bribes at roughly 39% of realised. Actual WOLF received was $0.60. Candidate for HYDREX_ROUTING_COINGECKO_FALLBACK_TOKENS; see audit_routing_price_divergence.py.
notes.cross_check: 22 of 24 priced rows agree with the vote-time snapshot within +/-8%; only cbBTC (0.09x) and WOLF (2.59x) diverge, both documented above.
